metadata.explanation: Ask the Session for its current instance: a READY one is acquired; otherwise the command releases the instance it holds, then waits until the Session announces the settlement of its request; a deployment resumes a reclaimed instance so its pinned processes are built.
Wait for one admitted command.
Wait, bounded, until the Session announces that the workspace request the command waits for settled, then acquire the workspace again.
Revoke broker admission durably before provider cleanup begins; a start that releases the instance it held stays STARTING.
End the Preview of a deleting Project: discard pending messages, cancel the queued deployment and complete.
Commit command completion, admit the queued deployment or the release of what a start or deployment began without serving, and tell the Session a READY start or wait for the next command.
Start the Sandbox-local Preview engine, or find it running, until its Dex answers through the instance's own Sandbox Service.
Tell the Session, best effort, the outcome of a deployment, a start or a source preparation as one delivery notification, then wait for the next command.

Validate the configuration of the prepared commit and pin it, its Live storage, the Sandbox principal and the grant generation by immutable references; a configuration that lacks what the source declares is refused with every gap, and the running Preview is left untouched.
Compile and render processes from the pinned commit's exported tree for a deployment or the clean pushed HEAD otherwise: register its manifest and generate immutable FDG from an isolated archive.
Reconcile the Project's route to the instance under its stable host and probe through the real gateway until it answers, then READY.
Read the Git-owned version of the pinned push or clean HEAD and persist its name before compiling processes.
Record that the Pod deletion stops a Preview engine whose graceful stop reached its wait limit or ran out of retries, with the cause, and complete the release.

Record the failure of a provider Step whose retries ran out or whose wait limit passed, with the final error, end its command and admit the queued deployment or the release of what a failed start or deployment began without serving.
Record a definite refusal a Step decided, with its cause and owner, end its command and admit the queued deployment or the release of what a refused start or deployment began without serving.
Route the admitted command into its durable lifecycle.
Issue or reuse the storage grant, start the prepared commit's application through the supervisor until it runs, then revoke the grant it superseded.
Remove the Project's route, stop the application and revoke the Preview grants; giving up the instance then stops the engine, while an explicit stop and the release of a deployment keep it.
Stop the Sandbox-local Preview engine before the Session deletes its Pod; an engine that does not stop gracefully is stopped by the Pod deletion.
Require the acquired instance's READY source preparation, which the start deploys whatever the workspace holds now.

diagnostics.message: group "preview" is neither one run of Steps that lead to each other nor one choice that a single Step makes; it falls into 2 parts: AwaitPreviewCommands, RoutePreviewCommand, AcquireSessionWorkspace, AwaitWorkspaceSettled, CompletePreviewCommand, RecordPreviewRefusal, ReadPreviewSourceVersion, PreparePreviewSource, VerifyPreviewSource, PreparePreviewConfiguration, EnsurePreviewEnvironment, StartPreview, ProbeAndExposePreview, NotifyPreviewOutcome, BeginPreviewStop, StopPreview, StopPreviewEnvironment; CompletePreview. Split it so that each group does one thing
